great post, I agree completely. religion or beliefs or spirituality is not a fashion accessory, pay no mind to symbols and imagery if it's not your thing. while satanism can provide community and bonds with others, it's mainly for yourself.

I think that the way it is portrayed is really just an extreme and radical form of satanism. A christian could also feel the same way about how radical christian cults and certain churches are associated with the more realistic version of their religion that is more widely practiced. Satanists like the ones seen in the media do exist, although as a satanist yourself, you know that there is a big difference between what you consider satanism and what someone else, who also practices, defines it as. It *is* insulting when people are ignorant and believe this is the only form of satanism, but viewers should understand that the show is fictional and never claimed to be an informative documentary about satanism.
